title: Genesis Bond — Cycle 142
description: The first Stacks Bitcoin Staking bond, with direct native-L1 and approved StackingDAO pool participation routes.

attestation.scope: Genesis Bond schedule and the two approved participation routes

economics.rewardSource: Bond rewards distributed by the PoX-5 signer-manager, capped by available rewards.

protocolTerms.coverageBoundary: Stacks PoX-5 Bitcoin Staking only; STX-only stacking and non-Stacks yield products are excluded.
protocolTerms.signerAndAdministrationControls: PoX-5 bond state and signer-manager permissions must be reconciled from the active contracts; product enrollment is separately administered.
audits: PoX-5 protocol assurance is tracked in the cited public security material.
unresolvedTerms: Final capacity, duration, manager fees, enrollment window, and deployed pool/LST contracts remain pending.

participationRoutes.name: Genesis native-L1 direct

attestation.scope: Direct native-L1 Genesis Bond participation and custody requirements

participationRoutes.summary: Institutional direct participation using a Bitcoin L1 timelock, subject to allowlisting and an approved custody path.

enrollment.method: Product-owner allowlist and bond registration flow; public enrollment link pending.

recovery.evidence: The PoX-5 native-L1 path uses participant-supplied maturity recovery material; product execution must be verified per custody path.

earlyExit.evidence: No bond-specific operational early-exit commitment is published.

participationRoutes.name: StackingDAO Genesis sBTC pool

attestation.scope: StackingDAO as the approved permissionless sBTC pool for the Genesis Bond

participationRoutes.summary: Permissionless smaller-balance participation through the approved StackingDAO pool, using sBTC on Stacks.

rewardAccounting.method: Pool-level pro-rata accounting; final published accounting details are pending.

attestation.scope: stBTC as an optional capability of the StackingDAO Genesis sBTC pool

liquidityEvidence.description: Transferability is not evidence of reliable exit liquidity or borrowing support.

oracleEvidence.description: No current pool-specific oracle design or dependency evidence is published.

notes: The schedule is product-owner confirmed but not proof that the bond is configured on-chain or enrollment is open.
StackingDAO is the only approved seeded pool; stBTC is represented only as that pool's optional LST capability.
